name: Hornet HNT-151 — sculpt-source study
notes:
Hornet insect-like suspended ovoid cockpit and very slender, inward-jointed stilt legs, distinct asymmetric right-torso LRM-5 wing pod; no arm manipulators. Source anchors: TRO 3039 and N-scale Hornet frontal resin photos. 2026 multi-view resculpt: replaced bulky forearms with small weapons suspended below a central spheroid; sunken cockpit and slender strut legs, retained physical sockets.
Second source pass: individually separate lower arm, shin, torso/launcher moving masses; require fully rooted and face-connected assembly.
Reference resculpt: independently shape tiny left and right laser stalks under a round canopy; do not copy the LRM pod as the opposite arm.
Load-bearing shoulder bosses: separately authored contiguous 3D frame collars, 5+ coarse-cell z-span, no isolated floating armor lips; broad arm bearings retained while surrounding profiles remain slim.
